meta.units: reactor units (count); no capacity is used

states.construction: WNA 'under construction': first concrete poured (includes units where construction is suspended)
states.planned: WNA 'planned': approvals, funding or commitment in place, mostly expected to operate within 15 years

sources.counts: World Nuclear Association, World Nuclear Power Reactors & Uranium Requirements, page dated 2026-11-11, accessed 2026-11-11
sources.units: World Nuclear Association country profiles, accessed 2026-11-11; France and USA operating units and Pakistan's unit under construction from GEM
sources.locations: Global Energy Monitor, Global Nuclear Power Tracker, August 2026 release, CC BY 4.0

assumptions: China planned: San'ao 4 and Xuwei HTR-PM 600-1 appear in both the construction and the planned tables of the WNA China profile; counted as under construction only (WNA table: 39 planned).
France planned: the WNA table counts 2 planned units without naming them; counted, not drawn.
Japan planned: the WNA Japan profile lists Higashidori 1 (Tepco) as planned and deferred; the WNA table has 0 planned for Japan, and the table is used.
Site coordinates are the median of the GEM unit coordinates of the matched project, using only units with an exact location when the project has any.
